rows.Name: Witcher: The Professional
rows.Notes: Use an oil and kill 4 monsters. Note that bear fat (25) and repair (30) costs of one oil mean that using this contract to kill commons is only worth 5 coins, so you may want to switch it if you have no other uses for oil.

rows.Name: Swordmaster
rows.Notes: To parry, press and hold when the red 'attack warning' lights. Accumulates over multiple fights.

rows.Name: Not Quite Dragons
rows.Description: Kill 3 monsters from the draconid class.
rows.Notes: For example wyverns and forktails appear during the day. See also Bestiary.

rows.Name: Craft oils
rows.Notes: Access the crafting station in your inventory. 3 basic oils require a total of 15 Powdered monster tissue (from monster kills and Alchemist's packs) and 9 Bundles of herbs (harvested from the map or from Herbalist's packs)

rows.Name: Use oils
rows.Notes: An oil can be applied to the weapon in the start of the battle by selecting it into the oil slot.

rows.Name: Craft bombs
rows.Notes: 2 basic bombs will require total of 10 Powdered monster tissue, 6 Bundles of herbs, and 2 Roots (harvested from the map or from Herbalist's packs).

rows.Name: Throw bombs
rows.Notes: Bombs can be brewn in the inventory and are used in battle selection. The battle does not need to be won for the throws to count.

rows.Name: Burn 'em All
rows.Notes: The vulnerabilities of a monster can see in the Bestiary. It is not required to use a fire attack.

rows.Name: They're Both for Monsters
rows.Notes: The vulnerabilities of a monster can see in the Bestiary.
Parry an attack from a monster in combat by pressing and holding when the red attack warning sign appears above the critical hit bar.

rows.Name: Demonsterization
rows.Notes: Nemeta can only be accessed at level 10. They appear tree-like by walking around on the map.

rows.Name: Grumpy old creatures
rows.Description: Kill 3 monsters from the relict class.
rows.Notes: The class of a monster can be shown in the Bestiary.

rows.Name: Full moon rising
rows.Notes: A werewolf will only appear during full moon and has a one skull difficulty level. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Wet nightmare
rows.Description: Kill 3 monsters that usually live near water.
rows.Notes: For example Water Hags. Rain helps (potentially snowing as well). See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Ghostslayer
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters from the specter class.
rows.Notes: Wraiths are reasonably available easy monsters in the evening time. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Cadaver-eaters
rows.Notes: See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Two in One
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters from the hybrid class.
rows.Notes: For example the succubus. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Grumpy Old Creatures
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters from the relict class.
rows.Notes: For example the Spriggan Hound. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Deadly Swing
rows.Notes: For example the wererat. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: On the Path
rows.Description: Travel a distance of at least 1 km.
rows.Notes: Go for a walk.

rows.Name: As Strong as a Horse
rows.Notes: To perform a strong attack, swipe more slowly during a fight. These do not need to be completed in a single fight.

rows.Name: Soaking Dead
rows.Notes: Drowners spawn near water or during rain. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Ogre My Dead Body
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters from the ogroid class.
rows.Notes: For example nekkers. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: Full of Terrors
rows.Notes: For example a vampire. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: High Noon
rows.Notes: The noonwraith spawns only around midday. See also: Bestiary.

rows.Name: The Magician
rows.Notes: Any sign will do, for example igni.

rows.Name: Vertical
rows.Description: Kill 3 monsters moving on two limbs.

rows.Name: On Your Guard
rows.Description: Parry an opponent's attacks 3 times in 1 fight.

rows.Name: Big-Game Hunting
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters vurnerable to strong attacks.

rows.Name: Boy, Do They Suck!
rows.Description: Kill 3 monsters from the vampire class.

rows.Name: Deadly Fast
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters vurnerable to fast attacks.

rows.Name: Pest control
rows.Description: Kill 5 monsters from the insectoid class.

In {{TWMS}}, '''Contracts''' are optional small quests which the character can undertake in exchange for gold coins. Contracts are accessed through the contract menu in the lower right corner of the map view. == Daily Tasks == After the November 2021 update, 3 contracts are given a day. If a contract has not been completed, completing one the next day frees up a slot and the third (or second, etc) contract of the new day will appear again. One contract can be changed once a day by pressing the circular-arrow reload icon in the upper right corner of the page. After this it is possible to 'delete' a contract by pressing the trashbin icon, which has the same effect as completing it would be, without rewards. == Daily Hunt == In addition, the first kill of a day gives a stamp shown on the Daily Hunt stamp list. One stamp can be earned a day, and collecting 5 stamps rewards a [[The Witcher Monster Slayer scrolls|summoning scroll]]. == Timed Tasks == An additional set of themed "[[The Witcher Monster Slayer timed tasks|Timed Tasks]]" have been added in the November update into a tab behind the daily, which can provide additional rewards and coins if they are all completed. Occasionally, there have been bugs in claiming specific missions even though they show up as complete, and the fixes have been prompt. It is worth noting that in the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer timed tasks|timed tasks]], the phrasing '''"Kill while using only "''', for example "Kill any monster from the OGROID class while using only SIGNS", means that: * You can do damage with signs, obviously, but also * You may use potions and oils, AND * It is also ok to cause and avoid damage as a side effect of normal or perfect parrying. In other words, to "kill only by using signs" means you must kill without using fast or strong attacks or bombs, but all other boosters are fine. Similarly killing only with bombs allows parrying, but probably not any signs. == Inventory of Potential Daily Tasks == Note: After the May 2022 update, task rewards have changed (seems that they have increased).
